2495 Ionas {ee-o-nas'}

源自希伯來文 SNH03124; TDNT - 3:406,380; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Jonas (the prophet) 9, Jona (father of Peter) 4; 13

約拿 = "鴿子"
1) 舊約先知
2) 西門彼得與安德烈的父親
record.edic_text:
2495 Ionas {ee-o-nas'}

of Hebrew origin 03124; TDNT - 3:406,380; n pr m

AV - Jonas (the prophet) 9, Jona (father of Peter) 4; 13

Jonah or Jonas = "dove"
1) the fifth minor prophet, the son of Amittai, and a native of
   Gath-hepher and lived during the reign of Jeroboam II, king of Israel
2) Jonas, the father of Peter
